description: JSON I/O contract for Enana LLM-facing agent functions and retrieval tools.

functions.name: agent_get_io_contract
functions.description: Returns this JSON contract to clients/agents.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Read project records by semantic keyword or exact term.

tools.name: search_protocols
tools.description: Read protocol records, including names and step snippets.

tools.name: search_notebook_entries
tools.description: Read notebook entries with result summaries and timestamps.

tools.name: search_assays
tools.description: Read assay runs with plate metadata and compact numeric summaries.

tools.name: search_gel_analyses
tools.description: Read gel analysis runs with confidence, calibration, and warning summaries.

tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description: Read chemical and personal inventory records.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Read uploaded paper summaries, methods, and reagent extraction notes.

tools.name: search_uniprot
tools.description: Search UniProtKB protein knowledgebase records by keyword, accession, or gene/protein term.

tools.name: search_pubmed
tools.description: Search PubMed literature records and return article metadata for biomedical queries.

tools.name: search_crossref
tools.description: Search Crossref works metadata by title, DOI, author, or keyword.

tools.name: search_europe_pmc
tools.description: Search Europe PMC literature records with PubMed/PMCID/DOI metadata.

tools.name: toolbox_molarity_calculator
tools.description: Compute molarity, mass, volume, concentration, or dilution conversions used in the Toolbox Molarity Calculator.

tools.name: toolbox_peptide_properties
tools.description: Compute peptide mass, pI, net charge, residue counts, and extinction coefficients used in the Toolbox Peptide Properties view.

tools.name: toolbox_buffer_preparer
tools.description: Compute required masses or liquid volumes for buffer component preparation from Toolbox-style component definitions.

tools.name: toolbox_dna_to_protein
tools.description: Convert DNA/RNA sequence to translated protein sequence with frame and stop-codon handling used in Toolbox DNA to Protein.

tools.name: toolbox_protein_to_dna
tools.description: Reverse-translate protein sequence to DNA with optional codon profile, stop codon append, and restriction-site avoidance.

tools.name: toolbox_oligo_properties
tools.description: Compute DNA/RNA oligo molecular weight, extinction coefficient, and approximate Tm.

tools.name: toolbox_extinction_coefficient
tools.description: Compute extinction coefficient for protein/peptide or DNA/RNA sequences.

tools.name: toolbox_qpcr_efficiency
tools.description: Compute qPCR efficiency from slope or standard-curve points.

tools.name: toolbox_plannotate
tools.description: Run pLannotate-like plasmid annotation using plain-text sequence input only (no file/blob inputs).

tools.name: toolbox_crispr_sgrna_designer
tools.description: Design CRISPR sgRNA candidates from target sequence text and scoring parameters.

tools.name: run_python_sandbox
tools.description: Compute tool. Run Python code in an isolated temporary sandbox for deterministic calculations, parsing, and transformations. Use this when retrieval tools are insufficient and the task needs programmatic computation.

tools.name: download_paper_pdf
tools.description: Write tool. Download one paper PDF and optional SI PDFs into storage path under Project/JournalClub folders.
